one_liner: Franz Wagner scores 23.8 points per 36 minutes while shooting 30 percent from three -- scoring volume that comes from everywhere but the arc.
three_things: 23.8 points per 36 on just 30 percent three-point accuracy.
Overall efficiency stays at 47.2 percent, so the interior game is carrying it.
85.4 percent free-throw shooting suggests the mechanics are not the problem.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
